title: Cross Site Scripting/Injection in Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.X to 3.0.0 inclusive on all platforms allows an attacker…
description: Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.X through 3.0.0 inclusive contain a Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows attackers to inject unescaped input when creating new pages. This issue can lead to the execution of malicious scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability is fixed in version 3.0.1, and users are advised to upgrade to this version to mitigate the risk.
